The present petition seeks quashing of FIR No. 304/2023, registered under Sections 323/341/354/34 IPC at P.S. Harsh Vihar, on the basis of a Settlement Agreement dated 09th January, 2025 executed between the Petitioners and the complainant.

Apart from the impugned FIR, the complainant has also lodged FIR No. 60/2023 under Sections 376/506/34 IPC at P.S.
Aman Vihar.
2. Although the two FIRs are registered at different police stations, there is hardly any time gap between the incidents.
Moreover, under the Settlement Agreement, Respondent No. 2 has agreed to cooperate with the accused in seeking quashing of the FIRs.
